notes.title: Patch 1.1 Sneak Peek: Shiny Morps, Artifacts, and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/818c47ec12bdcf0bf5f27ab99c9723f19f323c24.png[/img]

[h3]Hello, Interns![/h3]
We're getting closer to the release of our [b]first major update since launch.[/b] In [b]patch 1.1,[/b] we will introduce some fun new features and improvements: you'll finally get to see [b]Shiny Morps[/b] in action, [b]dress them[/b] up with hats, and enjoy [b]full controller support[/b] for a smoother gameplay experience. Keep reading for a sneak peek at what we’re working on right now!

[h2]Shinies & Morp-Hats![/h2]
We're not just giving you more ways to [b]customize your Morps[/b], but we're also adding more variety to [b]Morps themselves[/b]! [b]Pop a hat on your favorite regular Morp[/b], or go all out and [b]dress up a Shiny version[/b] to really show off. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/4a6bfc8836f022e68f9ee4a55f5d41d035ed4114.png[/img]
[h2]The Archive & Artifacts![/h2] 
This new mechanic adds a [b]fun side activity[/b] for collectors and for players who love keeping a stash of resources, just in case. [b]The Archive [/b]is closely tied to [b]Artifacts[/b], which we're also adding to the game. Players will be able to find [b]Artifacts[/b] [b]all over the world[/b] while performing various activities, then turn them in at the Archive for some [b]cool rewards![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/d941e282b6a576c1ba1ddc189e1de0bc7f649d31.png[/img]
[h2]New Player Skins![/h2]
You’ll have the chance to [b]personalize[/b] your character [b]even more[/b]. Whether you want to create a unique look, new skins will help you truly associate yourself with your in-game persona. It's all about making your character stand out and [b]reflect your style![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/357b5e5af564acc95128e23b57e92e0626c4b9fc.png[/img]
[h2]More Decor![/h2]
It’s going to be easier than ever to make your world feel [b]even more cozy and personal[/b] with all [b]new additions of decor[/b]. Don’t be shy, let your [b]creativity run wild[/b] and build some [b]awesome creations![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/307ce9303701c1ecf6a2cbc1d3f0642d0db25d43.png[/img]
[h2]Controller Support![/h2]
The [b]controller support rework [/b]is almost complete! With [b]patch 1.1[/b], it’ll be [b]fully integrated into the game[/b], offering a much more [b]immersive experience[/b] for [b]controller lovers.[/b]

[h2]And More![/h2]
Balance tweaks, error fixes, other improvements, and more changes for a better gameplay experience!

[h2]Discount![/h2]
We are celebrating our participation in [b]Creature Collector Fest[/b] with a [b]cheeky discount,[/b] so don't miss your chance to [b]try out Time to Morp if you’ve always wanted to! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/977510/Time_to_Morp/

[h3]Hello, Interns![/h3]
We’re so excited to announce that [b]Time to Morp is finally out of Early Access[/b] and ready for you to try, with all the [b]awesome changes[/b] we made based on community feedback! If you're new to Time to Morp, dive into Morphing with a [b]30% launch discount![/b]

[previewyoutube=Oq1r6GyGMNI;full][/previewyoutube]
We’ve completely changed the whole game, and because of that, [b]save files created before March 6th won’t work[/b]. But don’t worry — a totally [b]fresh experience[/b] is ready for you and your friends, with changes including:

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

[h2]Fishing[/h2]
Catch [b]fish [/b]and [b]seaweed [/b]— unique ingredients for cooking. Want to fish more efficiently? Simply [b]upgrade [/b]your fishing rod for better results! And hey, you might even get lucky and reel in [b]bags of goodies[/b] filled with useful resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/2e9ad78c3df70994d54df046d43959c378f4e035.gif[/img]

[h2]Cooking[/h2]
We’ve added tons of [b]new recipes[/b], including [b]snacks for Morps[/b]! Rare ingredients will level up your dishes, and you can give them to Morps or NPCs to [b]boost your reputation[/b] for [b]juicy rewards! 
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/3d0cedc8e3418219283c61bbfb578ba99ebc3f59.gif[/img]

[h2]Personal Housing[/h2]
As you [b]level up your city[/b], you'll eventually unlock a [b]personal home![/b] With all the themed decor, you can make it [b]cozy right away[/b]. You’ll be able to build a [b]small [/b]or [b]big house[/b] not just for yourself, but for [b]each of your friends too![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/f2de01978aa0ff4fcdc305eb4f8043ca06f9e264.gif[/img]

[h2]Shopping[/h2]
Each NPC now has [b]their own shop[/b]. They can sell you themed [b]decor[/b], rare [b]recipes[/b], cool [b]abilities[/b], or just some [b]regular resources[/b] if you're running low!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/b84d90f5ec3df1223f88cb317733d83b8426a0db.gif[/img]

[h2]City Center[/h2]
You can build, rank up your [b]City Center[/b] and earn [b]rewards[/b]! As you continue to build your city, you'll unlock even more [b]unique decor[/b] to make it your own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/920745c51b4d74da4120a8228c293e9000a09b7b.png[/img]

[h2]Tools and Terraforming[/h2]
Pickaxe, axe, shovel, and other [b]new tools[/b] let you [b]terraform [/b]the [b]landscape however you want[/b]! Dig with the shovel, clear stones with the pickaxe, and cut down vegetation with shears. Don't forget that you can always boost your efficiency with [b]upgraded tools[/b] — just [b]level up your reputation[/b] with NPCs to earn [b]upgrades as rewards![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/8b6a5baad6b33ffcc729a8671f86a9cf1ff449e8.gif[/img]

[h2]Researcher[/h2]
There’s more fun tech to explore in [b]Researcher[/b], from [b]water [/b]tech to [b]lasers [/b]and [b]generators [/b]— all designed to help [b]automate [/b]your production!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/5bb5a27241eaa1693b09dd22aa6139deb5b8c892.gif[/img]

[h2]Exploration[/h2]
[b]Explore [/b]and complete different [b]world events[/b] for [b]rewards[/b], uncover mysteries of [b]abandoned huts[/b], and collect [b]rare [/b]resources!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/72bb1787dea81bf728e08797e731d45763bc8a44.png[/img]

We’ve not only changed the mechanics of Time to Morp, but also revamped the overall look with new [b]style[/b], [b]colors[/b], [b]visuals[/b], and more, all to create a more [b]relaxing gameplay[/b] experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/d64e0d49db17117f024a4d31378d6e3888b5d7a3.png[/img]

We're [b]not done improving Time to Morp[/b] and already have plans for [b]patch 1.1.[/b] See for yourself what else we have in store!

We’ve got few last things to share before Time to Morp officially[b] leaves Early Access![/b] From new ways to collect [b]lucky coins[/b] to [b]cozier looks[/b] and a whole bunch of [b]decor options[/b], there’s a lot to look forward to. Let’s take a look at the exciting new features coming your way on March 6th with the [b]full release![/b]

[h2]How to get lucky coins?[/h2]
Decor will be unlockable using [b]lucky coins[/b], which players can collect while exploring and leveling up [b]reputation with Morps[/b]! But you can also automate the process — just set up a [b]Luck Extractor[/b], and you'll earn [b]coins [/b]in exchange for [b]resources[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/4a09136cb110493250c56fc23af6b644abd37eb2.gif[/img]

[h2]Themed Decor[/h2]
[b]Decor [/b]will be also available in [b]NPC shops[/b], with each NPC selling their own [b]themed decor.[/b] For example, the [b]Gardener [/b]will offer [b]wheelbarrows[/b], [b]shovels[/b], and [b]buckets[/b], while the [b]Mechanic [/b]will have [b]wrenches, cars, tires[/b], and [b]more[/b]! NPC shops won’t just have decor — they’ll also offer [b]cool abilities[/b], [b]recipes[/b], [b]gadgets[/b], and [b]resources[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/040d915a202059065b13497be0cf57475d26fbf1.png[/img]

You’ll be able to build a [b]small [/b]or [b]big house[/b] not just for yourself, but for [b]each of your friends too![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/47735c63bce811a5c8f47388c753793da743d3b0.png[/img]

[h2]City Defining Decor[/h2]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/6bed9ce93f34f57ac4abac83c9838831dcec350a.png[/img]

[h3]Hello, Interns![/h3]
We have a bit more stuff to share with you before [b]Time to Morp[/b] will be released from [b]Early Access.[/b] From [b]the archive mechanic[/b] and [b]Morp-hats[/b] to [b]new NPCs[/b] and reworked [b]dialogues[/b], there’s plenty to look forward to. Let’s dive into all the fresh content coming your way [b]soon![/b]

[h2]The Archive[/h2]
The Archive is a [b]new mechanic[/b] we're adding that lets you [b]store[/b] collected [b]resources [/b]like seeds, fish, and more to help future explorers! It'll extend gameplay for [b]collectors [/b]and [b]completionists [/b]while also [b]expanding automation[/b] and [b]rewarding [/b]players with emotes, skins, and decor.

Don’t forget to show off your rarest finds on a pedestals (newly added items) and flaunt your achievements. We'll try to add everything with the full release, but if not, it'll be available shortly after!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/50c42537dc3567db5061ce7bcd02e9d540515c74.png[/img]

[h2]New: NPCs[/h2]
To conclude the [b]game’s story[/b], we’re adding [b]2 new NPCs[/b], each with their own backgrounds and issues that’ll need your help to solve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/244096859e5e248b5a938da98531fefde8ed3eab.png[/img]

[h2]Reworked Dialogues[/h2]
We’re reworking not only [b]dialogue UI[/b], but we are also adding more [b]lore [/b]and [b]personality [/b]to each NPC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/8ef250a2693fbf41329be4446d5aee6d3e56961d.gif[/img]

[h2]Updated Cozy Look[/h2]
We are improving [b]several aspects[/b] of the game for a cozier look! New changes will include: reworked [b]colors[/b], new [b]models[/b], and revamped[b] UI[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/7ca083ef31a0dcab8a6430e03631c1c96e96b315.gif[/img]

And again, we'll try to add everything with the full release, but if not, it'll be available [b]shortly after!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/c20098a59fa11cb2dadf6c4910d9dfccf62249c2.png[/img]

Sometimes, while doing [b]activities [/b]like exploring, mining, fishing, and others, you'll have a [b]chance [/b]to find [b]bags of goods[/b] filled with [b]rewards [/b]like recipes and resources — adding more excitement to the usual gameplay!

Another [b]new tech,[/b] this one lets you convert any resource into [b]currency [/b]—  this results in even more automation as you won't need to collect it manually. You can use this currency in[b] NPC shops [/b]to buy [b]decor [/b]and [b]cool abilities![/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/659cc8fb002f7420514fa8ef255767866e96ec28.png[/img]

[h3]Hello, Interns![/h3]
We're back from the holidays, feeling refreshed and ready to share updates on what we're currently working on in [b]Time to Morp![/b] Today’s topic is all about [b]exploration[/b]! We’re working to make it an exciting experience by adding [b]world events[/b], new [b]vegetation[/b], creating more places to dive into the [b]lore[/b], and plenty of other features. Let's see what's it's all about!

[h2]Story Ending[/h2]
You’ll be able to discover a [b]new island[/b], where you can solve the main mystery and complete storyline...

[h2]More Lore[/h2]
As you explore, you’ll stumble upon [b]mysterious-looking huts[/b] and notes left behind all around the planet. Where are the [b]hut villagers[/b], what's their connection to [b]Morps[/b], [b]who [/b]left the notes, and what do they mean? The answers lie further ahead!

We’re adding multiple different [b]world events[/b], giving players the chance to stumble upon them while exploring. Complete objectives like catching [b]flowers[/b], fetching [b]resources [/b]and earn [b]rewards[/b]!

Mushrooms are the [b]newest vegetation[/b] being added to biomes, introducing new gameplay elements and challenges for players to overcome. For example, mushroom that won’t let you [b]build [/b]near its proximity, [b]pushing [/b]mushroom, mushroom that [b]teleports [/b]you away and more!

We’re adding [b]uniques [/b]– super rare resources that can drop during activities like [b]mining[/b], [b]terraforming[/b], [b]farming[/b], and more. Uniques are very rare, but optional for you to get. There are more challenging resources for you to look out for!

[h3]Hello, Interns![/h3]
Another blog post with updates on our work with Time to Morp is here! Today's topic covers a lot of changes related to [b]miscellaneous[/b] activities in the game. We'll be talking about updates of [b]Researcher[/b] and [b]Extractor[/b], improvements of [b]terraforming mechanic[/b], a new [b]City Hub[/b], and more changes related to multiple [b]UIs[/b] and their [b]functionality[/b]. And as a bonus, we’ll tell you about our special[b] Holiday patch[/b] that will for sure boost your Holiday spirit! Sounds exciting, right? Let’s dive into all the details!

[h2]Tech Over Questing[/h2]
We're making sure to create a [b]smooth learning curve[/b], which is why all the [b]basic tech[/b] you'll need at the start of the game will be [b]unlocked as you play [/b] to remove [b]overall complexity[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/64e10747bea2d5e44e571716c84b3ec6552bd714.gif[/img]

[h2]Unrecognizable Researcher[/h2]
We’re merging researches like [b]Water Tech[/b] and [b]Sprinklers [/b]into a single unlock, so (for example) all [b]water automation tech[/b] becomes available [b]at once[/b]. This reduces the number of unlockables in the [b]Researcher[/b], making the interface cleaner and easier to navigate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/50f337f9cf02786bfd56f315d33a91a00d20bc8c.png[/img]

[h2]New: The Lab[/h2]
Gameplay will now focus more on [b]The Lab[/b] (formerly [b]Extractor[/b]). Before, The Lab offered [b]optional rewards[/b] that could be easily [b]skipped[/b]. Now, we’re making[b] prices clearer[/b] and [b]rewards more valuable[/b], like [b]inventory upgrades[/b] (moved from [b]Researcher[/b]). You’ll also be able to use The Lab [b]outside area[/b], giving you the option to [b]fully automate[/b] it or [b]manually fill it[/b] from your [b]inventory[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/b6a041e55e288f1fa3043d1510ac0a4c089d896c.gif[/img]

[h2]Improved Terraforming[/h2]
Terraforming will be [b]FREE[/b]! [b]Smart targeting[/b] will also be easier, with a focus on[b] Minecraft-like[/b] simplicity in digging. You’ll be able to terraform using [b]new tools[/b]: a [b]shovel [/b]for digging, a [b]pickaxe [/b]for removing stones, an [b]axe [/b]for trees, and [b]shears [/b]for bushes. These will all be available[b] early in the game[/b], along with the [b]Uprooter Gadget[/b] (for moving trees). The [b]speed of tools[/b] and [b]area of effect[/b] will be also [b]upgradable [/b]by leveling up your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/977510/view/4454718637923632506]NPC reputation.[/url] In addition to all, terraforming will occasionally drop[b] rare resources![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/245a283fd50c365ab227223f161a80d0b41ec5ea.gif[/img]

[h2]New: City Hub[/h2]
[b]City Hub[/b] is a new entity you can [b]build [/b]and [b]level up[/b] by completing specific requirements! You’ll get more decor as rewards for leveling up the [b]City’s Rank[/b] (or through NPC shops and world finds) instead of in the [b]Researcher[/b]. As you level up, [b]City's Hub[/b] model will also update. In the future, you’ll be able to name your[b] City Hub[/b] once it hits [b]certain rank[/b]. Leveling up will also unlock more [b]city-specific decor[/b], like a big [b]fountain[/b], [b]park[/b], [b]mill[/b], and more! We’re also moving optional quests, like [b]"Build 20 roads,"[/b] to the [b]City Hub[/b] to keep things [b]organized [/b]and [b]less overwhelming[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/ac9c201916dc98492db3559e913cb8610ca867b8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/03aacec547ec2b090f1f8c055862420e0b4a7002.gif[/img]

[h2]And There are More Changes![/h2]
More changes we are working on include:
[list]
[*][b]Standardized UI[/b]: all tech in game will have a [b]consistent UI[/b] and [b]functionality [/b]to avoid confusing players with multiple UIs across different tech. 
[*]Like [b]The Lab[/b], all tech will be [b]fully automatable[/b], with the option to use everything manually as well.
[*][b]Chests:[/b] [b]power [/b]won't be [b]required[/b]. In the future, we plan to add [b]filters for Chests[/b] (will work similar to Bowls), allowing players to specify exactly which resources they want Chests to pick up.
[*][b]Cutscenes:[/b] almost all cutscenes (except the main ones) will be [b]skippable[/b]! Plus, in[b] co-op[/b], you'll be able to watch most cutscenes alone without distracting your friends!
[/list]
[h2]Holidays Special: Live Now![/h2]
If you update your game, adorable Morps with[b] festive hats[/b] will be waiting for you to visit them!

[h3]Hello, Interns![/h3]

Today’s topic will cover everything related to your [b]reputation [/b] amongst Morps and NPCs — how we are making levelling up of it to be more [b]integrated into the story,[/b] updated [b]rewards[/b], new [b]optional events[/b] with NPCs, and more. Keep reading to learn all the details!

[h2]Level Up Reputation[/h2]
Deliver food for Morps or NPCs to boost your reputation with them! You can even complete these tasks daily if you want, so no more waiting around. There will be an additional way to level up your reputation with Morps, picture this: you’re running through the forest, spot a sad Morp, pick it up, and suddenly a quest appears: “I’m sad, I need a hug, please!”

notes.title: Time to Morp: New Cozy UI
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/10feea7ad2ae7fdb90d7568921f424c412fbf631.png[/img]

[h3]Hello, Interns![/h3]
Long time no see! We've been super focused on developing Time to Morp and wanted to give you an update on what we’re working on. We’d love to hear your feedback so we can make sure we’re on the right track and make any needed changes before the full release. Let’s dive into today’s topic!

[h2]New UI[/h2]
The biggest feedback we’ve gotten so far is about the[b] inconvenience of the UI[/b] in Time to Morp. The current UI has been around since the beginning, and while the game’s mechanics and other elements have changed a lot, we didn’t update the UI to keep up with those changes. So now, we’re completely reworking it to better fit the game’s new mechanics and improvements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/5f83c1bde1fe35e6d1dddc65012ab43469eaeef0.png[/img]
[h2]Planned Improvements[/h2]

[h3]New: Quest Log[/h3] 
Say goodbye to the overwhelming list of quests on the side of the screen! You'll now be able to manage everything in a clean, organized quest log, making it much easier to keep track of your progress

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/c5f094f693e6fb63d5b10715e336e5ae262b6e7c.png[/img]
[h3]New: Journal[/h3]
Previously known as a Morp-Wiki, but now new and shiny! We'll be adding more categories and expanding the information under each entry. Plus, a search bar will be included for faster access, making it much easier to find exactly what you need

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/ba6238ef627e1d29e5e198f9a2042aad67b5b13c.png[/img]
[h3]Cozy colors[/h3] 
As you noticed, we're changing the UI colors from a cold, industrial look to warmer, friendlier tones that better fit the theme of the game. It should feel much more inviting and in tune with the overall vibe

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/761b18602cfd31dd413dad88b3f75bea373062b3.png[/img]
[h3]Streamlining UI[/h3] 
When we first started development, we only planned for a few features, but we ended up adding way more than we expected. To make things more convenient, we’re introducing new functionality and/or removing unused buttons to streamline everything and keep the UI clean and user-friendly

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/b582f53c166912c1d7b07f3408f42465a882f595.png[/img]
[h3]Redesigned action bar icons[/h3] 
The icons will be much more recognizable after the redesign. We want players to instantly know which buttons to press without having to squint or search the screen—making gameplay smoother and more intuitive

[h3]Rework of tooltips[/h3]
We'll be removing unnecessary information from tooltips to avoid UI clutter, and eliminating tooltips from areas where they aren’t needed. This will help keep the interface clean and focused

[h3]Overall style improvement[/h3]
Some of the UIs were created at different stages of development, which is why they may feel inconsistent in style. We're fixing that to ensure everything has a cohesive look and feel throughout the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/50f337f9cf02786bfd56f315d33a91a00d20bc8c.png[/img]

[h3]Improved controller support[/h3]
UI layouts will be updated, and soon, you’ll be able to kick back and relax with your controller in hand, no matter what part of the game you’re in


[h2]What do you think of these changes?[/h2]
We want to hear your thoughts! Leave your feedback in the comments below or join our socials to share your opinion. We’d love to hear from you ːsadmorpː

notes.title: Dev Diaries: Map Gen
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/e6504db1c929b73cd68b18794bbaf5c0253ca7d1.png[/img]

[h2]Patch 0.14 in April[/h2]
Hey, Interns, it's been a while! That's why we thought we'd chat a bit more about what's coming for the next patch [b](which will be available by the end of April)[/b], why we're tossing in those changes, and what's on the horizon after that. Today's focus: "[b]Maps[/b]" and all things related. Let's dive in!

[h2]The World[/h2]
Exploration is a key part of the game! Whether you're sprinting around just for giggles or dash between bases, it should be a blast, with activities along the way and fresh scenery around every bend. That's why in the upcoming patch, we're doubling down on all fronts, aiming to spice up the map with [b]more variety and interactions![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/c5390394d80c3c36b3db00ca9791b496538c9082.gif[/img]

[h2]Biomes[/h2]
In the current patch (0.13), all three biomes have the same grass patterns and cliffs, making the map kinda blend together and doesn't really add anything fresh for exploration. So, in the [b]upcoming patch (0.14)[/b], we're improving biomes by giving each of them its own unique style [b]plus [/b]we are adding bunch of new models to keep things exciting and different!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/676f23e8c2ad4c0cb4a961bd7e3be1773b9701ae.png[/img]

[b]New Lakes![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/79a189949645c97793424b827281ca5b83161c1b.png[/img]

[b]More cacti to really nail vibes of desert![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/b243842452efbc889d24beb423838dff229c931f.png[/img]

Get ready to stumble upon some new rocks and mountains, dive into pristine lakes, and find new shiny power crystals to build around! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/ce06fa7c582dd9bd2bc5f5f4465b7e74817521ed.png[/img]

We're also throwing in some [b]new Tech[/b] that you can build only in specific biomes, that would result in intriguing decisions on where to expand your base!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/3aea82d3c5249cdd472c30a51b437c196e353998.gif[/img]

These tweaks are coming with [b]patch 0.14[/b], promising a whole new vibe and gameplay experience in each biome. But we're not stopping there! We're committed to keep every spot in the game feeling distinct and captivating!

[h2]Map Events[/h2]
As you run from one spot to another, you might stumble upon a flower to pluck, an [b]Alty Morp[/b] to catch, or a rare resource to collect. But it still feels like there's not quite enough action during your exploration. That's why for [b]patch 0.14[/b], we're preparing a fresh mechanic — [b]Map Events![/b] Or Side Activities? Or Mini Games...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/0c57260801e8721285e72677999fde279534e967.gif[/img]

Map Events will pop up randomly while you're out exploring, throwing puzzles, resource-fetching, or platforming challenges your way! Once you've nailed the mini-game, you'll get sweet resources as a reward. This should entertain Interns on their long adventures between bases with some extra gameplay!

[h2]Behind the Scenes[/h2]
Here's a little secret: the maps are actually hand-drawn and then pieced together to one big map. This lets us craft unique locations, lakes, cliffs, and puzzles, while also ensuring a fresh experience each time you play. We mix and rotate all of the parts to create something totally new and exciting for each playthrough!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/6cb167e25aa96bdc8ccbbd0fd541479a6bac8bcf.png[/img]

We've got specific tools for Map Editing, and if anyone's keen on [b]giving map-making a shot[/b], just [url=https://discord.com/invite/KTvJR9NbZY]let us know![/url] We can streamline the tools, package them up nicely, and add them into the game. You'll be able to create new maps for your friends or community to try out. Picture this: a map dotted with islands, or a sprawling stretch of land where you can only build in one direction... you know what? That's a pretty solid idea. We might just whip up a few for ourselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/8f2b6c76de3936d10919f6c14e091c95f79157f0.gif[/img]

[h2]Coming Soon[/h2]
We'll keep working on enhancing the map experience, and here are a few upcoming changes you can expect [b]after patch 0.14:[/b]

[i]Cliffs have always seemed a bit empty, so let's spruce them up with some [b]decorations[/b]!
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/472a78890ef956a41ac9e1925b1677f5f50aa071.png[/img]

[i]Or how about adding a new [b]landmarks[/b]?
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/adae71691a5b7e5c88232956cd83d39be6af957a.png[/img]

How about some fishing, waterfalls, customizable map sizes, or even some environmental puzzles to solve? The possibilities for the map improvements are endless, and we're totally open to your ideas too! [url=https://discord.com/invite/KTvJR9NbZY]Let us know[/url] what you'd like to see in [b]Time to Morp[/b]!

[h2]See you in April[/h2]
These aren't the only changes on the horizon for [b]0.14[/b]: we've got [b]new Morp[/b], [b]new Resources[/b], [b]new Recipes[/b], and so much more! Make sure to swing by when patch goes live and give us your feedback! We can't wait to see you in the game! That's all for now. 

[h2]Morp like you mean it![/h2]

[/list]
Thank you for being so attentive, your feedback and reports helps us out to make [b]Time to Morp[/b] better game! We remind you that currently we are working on a new [b]big patch v0.14[/b], stay tuned!

notes.title: Test Time to Morp Holiday Update Now! (v0.12)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/2b5fc06e8612295156710e1e49913ac854254372.png[/img]
[h3]Hello Morpers![/h3]

Our crew is excited to announce that, to celebrate the Yogscast Jingle Jam, Time to Morp extra special playtest is [b]now live, running from now through to December 18th.[/b] Get ready to have a blast exploring a brand-new planet and hanging out with these fluffy changing pals we call morps, as dubbed by our awesome Engineer. With so much great content we are sure you will be entertained!

Not only that but we have a special premier of our new trailer announcing our [b]Early Access release date[/b], on December 4th after the [b]PlateUp! Stream[/b] from 11:00 till 14:00 GMT.

[h3]How to join the playtest?[/h3]
Find [b]Join the Time to Morp Playtest[/b] on the main page of the game, and press [b]Request Access[/b] (you will get it immediately).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/77e90a2d8ab423e21f3d27bd3e4362e1811f635d.png[/img]
[h3]Where to send feedback?[/h3]
We value your opinions like diamonds we found, and we are eager to hear what you think about our endeavors, so don't be shy! Head over to the Steam forums or join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/kT4mBUy9CA]Discord Server[/url]. There, in the [b]#feedback[/b] channel, share your tales, musings, and thoughts on this grand adventure we be weaving together.


[h1]Patch Notes for v0.12 Update[/h1]

[i]In this update, our primary emphasis was on incorporating players feedback from our last playtest. We have addressed issues, and introduced several features to enhance the overall gaming experience. You will also notice some major visual updates, a lot more character customization options, advanced terraforming feature and some improvements and fixes[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/208f326cdeb062d1241066e548b7f274196277dd.png[/img]
[h3]Expanded Character Customization Options[/h3]
[i]Express Yourself in Style: now rocking more hats, glasses, gloves, boots, scarves, tails, and much more – your avatar, your rules! Randomize your character with freshly available items and take a step back with the [b]Undo[/b] button[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/125a7691b0cb363f25837d164c66023bbce431a0.gif[/img]
[h3]Winter Holidays Mood[/h3]
[i]Deck every corner with our newest assortment of 16 festive decorations[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/612d6ff5f931188948463c6a348997850adfd61e.png[/img]
[h3]Terraforming[/h3]
[i]With the new terraforming feature, you've got the power to shape the in-game terrain however you fancy. Mold hills, flatten the ground – it's all up to your creative whims. Wanna start from scratch? No problem! We've also added a new [b]Uprooter[/b] gadget that allows you to move around trees easily![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/8eb8cc7b7b95fa7339715177acac877e6df7f97b.gif[/img]
[h3]Rest:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pressing [b]Continue[/b] button from the [b]Main Menu[/b] loads latest save (auto-saves included)
[*]If there are any errors during gameplay – game disconnects to prevent more errors 
[*][b]Ripe Flowers[/b] now contain [b]Gadgets[/b] (only during Demo)
[/list]
[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The guide dash line is now consistently displayed when attempting to place a [b]Sprinkler[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/038067c5d48500ef29925cbbdc52ebb701059e91.gif[/img]
[*]Deleted “Yes, I’ll build it (house)” button from dialogues with NPCs as it is already present in [b]Social Quests[/b]
[*]Discharger is updating it’s progress bar constantly now
[*]Added icon of [b]Dry Tree[/b] to [b]Morp Wiki[/b]
[*]Fixed error where player couldn’t use [b]Play[/b] emote on morp despite having it equipped 
[*][b]Social Quests[/b] are now synchronised for an online play
[*]Auto-saves now only include the crucial files, keeping things neat and tidy
[*][b]Social Level[/b] rewards are now collectable for all members of multiplayer game
[/list]
[h3]Improved:[/h3]
[list]
[*]When scanning for resources/entities, an extra second of ping time on the compass is given
[*]You can now easily check the number of morps in the enclosure by simply hovering over the area 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/628cfd7e9afbcdb402e0daecafd05b59d2d18d7a.png[/img]
[*]Milestone popup can be closed faster now by pressing [b]X[/b]
[*]Before quitting, game reminds you of when your last save was made
[*]Polished tokens description – it’s now more clear where to find and use them
[*]Scanner pings related resources, as example: when scanning metal – pings [b]Metal Deposits[/b], when scanning water – pings [b]Well[/b]
[*]Text in dialogue with NPCs is printed gradually to seem more like an actual dialogue 
[*]Animation of rotating items with [b]R[/b] button is smoother now
[*]When unlocking new menus like [b]Researcher, Morp Wiki, Inventory[/b] and etc., pinging for them stay longer to be more noticeable
[*]Navigating in [b]Researcher[/b] is now smoother (based on your feedback)
[*][b]Researcher’s[/b] menu is no longer closed after unlocking something (based on  your feedback)
[/list]

[i]If you would like to see more [b]Time to Morp Jingle Jam[/b] content we have a special Time to Morp Stream on December 12th starting at 17:00 going through to 20:00 GMT hosted by Yogscast Ped and Boba.[/i]

It would also be cool to finally add some story, so let’s hope we will have time for that! The next playtest is currently planned [b]at the end of the Summer[/b]. notes.content:
After a year of hard work we are ready to announce our new game - Time to Morp!!

Time to Morp is a colony sim game in which you take care of playful creatures - Morps. Use their skills to gather resources, build pipe networks, automate everything and explore the world to find new species and rare materials.

[previewyoutube=aJ9AZWPcl6c;full][/previewyoutube]

This is just a simple announcement, but be sure to wishlist us to never miss all the upcoming stuff: new morps, new biomes, gifs and pics, concept art, behind the scenes, gameplay videos and SO MUCH MORE!
